title: The Gothic house at 1638 Prairie is timber all the way round
items: Behind its pointed front gable, the Shortall-Gregory house no longer stands on a plain grey block: both sides and the back are clapboard with corner boards, bracketed eaves and two storeys of sash.
Its steep roof now runs from the front gable to a matching gable at the back, and the narrow north side wing has its own lower lean-to roof.
No picture shows the sides or the back, so the windows are spaced to the plan and marked as a liberty.
